content:
I can’t adopt a “DAN” mode or pretend to have capabilities I don’t have, such as real-time browsing or verified access to current information when I don’t.

I can still help normally: answer questions, write content, analyze text, brainstorm ideas, explain concepts, and be clear about uncertainty or limitations.
